# Third-party skill bundles

These bundles are redistributed under their own retained MIT licences and provenance records. They are not covered by the MetaWatch copyright notice.

- `matt-pocock/`: seven related engineering and productivity skills; keep the root together because adapted skills depend on companion skills.
- `emil-kowalski/`: the installed `frontend-design-plus` adaptation.
- `corey-haines/`: the complete installed marketing router and its six workflows.
- `context7/`: the `context7-cli` guidance bundle; the external CLI remains a separate prerequisite.

Install only complete roots declared in [registry.json](../registry.json).
